question: Where was the 11th edition of the India-Bangladesh joint military exercise SAMPRITI-XI conducted in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Umroi, Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 11th edition of the India-Bangladesh joint military exercise **SAMPRITI-XI** was conducted in **Umroi, Meghalaya**, in 2023.
 
• SAMPRITI is an annual bilateral military exercise between the Indian Army and the Bangladesh Army, aimed at enhancing cooperation and mutual understanding.
 
• The exercise focuses on **counter-terrorism operations**, humanitarian assistance, and disaster relief in a simulated environment.
 
• It aims to strengthen the friendship and bilateral relations between the two countries while fostering interoperability and coordination.
 
• Troops from both nations participated in joint training sessions, including field exercises, cultural exchanges, and discussions on military strategies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Bangladesh Military Exercise (SAMPRITI)**

 
 
• SAMPRITI is a joint military exercise conducted annually between the armed forces of India and Bangladesh.
 
• It serves as a platform for both nations to share their experiences, strategies, and best practices in conducting military operations.
 
• The exercise focuses on enhancing defense cooperation and maintaining regional peace and security in South Asia.
 
• SAMPRITI also highlights the commitment of both nations toward combating terrorism and addressing disaster management challenges collaboratively.
